content.$t:
I have documented the money, the NGOs, the intelligence networks and the outcomes that don't match the official story. This is the complete set of The Ukraine Files, in the order I suggest reading them. Each post on this blog is built from a full X Article on @infinitumceo and links back to the original.

The series

  1. Audit Ukraine Aid: The NGO & CIA Shadow War Network
    Teaser now, the full X Article is coming soon. Western NGOs, card donations and the chain to charity tax IDs.
  2. Russia Wins: Sanctions, GDP, and the Isolation Lie
    The coalition, the sanctions record, the battlefield numbers and the cracks inside NATO.
  3. 78 Nations in Vladivostok: 328 Deals
    The 11th Eastern Economic Forum, Western admissions on sanctions, and Russia's pivot to Asia.
  4. IN-Q-TEL: The CIA's Venture Capital Arm
    What In-Q-Tel is, what it funds, and the Palantir, Anduril, Capella and ICEYE links to Ukraine.
  5. Meat Grinder to Medical Freezer
    An investigation into organ-trade allegations tied to the war, with the named sources and denials.
  6. Anatomy of the Geopolitical Puppet
    Intelligence, lobbying, charities and media behind Zelenskyy's rise, as I argue it.
  7. Forced Mobilization & the Kidnapping of a Nation
    Reports, cases and law on mobilization, plus the Russian civilian toll in Grandmas, Toddlers, and Forklift Drivers.
    Companion file: Russian Civilian Casualties and Ukrainian Strikes: Sources, the Russian civilian toll in detail, with named sources.
  8. Sweeps, Spies, and the Connections
    Russian sappers in Laos, the HALO Trust, and Moldova's Kolbasna report.

title.$t: About William Aaron Turner and The Ukraine Files

content.$t:
I'm William Aaron Turner, Founder and President of Infinitum Corporation, an international security and technology consulting firm headquartered in Washington, DC, with Moscow as an operating location. I work at the intersection of information technology, cybersecurity and modern military operations. I focus on bringing emerging technologies together with contemporary defense and security concepts.

I have spent years building expertise in cybersecurity, secure communications, network defense and emerging technologies. Infinitum Corporation applies that background to protecting digital infrastructure and supporting organizations in fast-changing environments. The firm's work covers network architecture and defense, ethical hacking and vulnerability assessment, ISTAR and C4ISR support, electronic warfare integration, irregular warfare analysis, drone and counter-UAS integration, and AI applications for security operations. Planned research includes autonomous systems, secure communications, unmanned aerial systems and advanced network resilience.

I believe that "success increasingly depends upon the ability to integrate intelligence, cyber capabilities, and operational decision-making into a unified framework." I write The Ukraine Files on this blog and on X, where I publish long-form articles at @infinitumceo.

Mission

I document the money, the NGOs, the intelligence networks and the outcomes that don't match the official story of the war in Ukraine. Each file in the series takes one thread and follows it: sanctions and the Russian economy, the Eastern Economic Forum, In-Q-Tel, forced mobilization, the charities and lobbying behind the war effort, and demining NGOs. Read them in order from the full series page, or jump to the one that matches today's headline.

Methodology: how each post is built

  • Every post on this blog is based on a full X Article published on @infinitumceo, and links to the original with its reference list.
  • The pieces draw on Western sources, FARA filings and open reporting, as well as official statements from governments and named individuals.
  • When a claim comes from a named person, outlet or government, the post says who made it.
  • Figures and quotes are carried over from the original article, and conclusions are labeled as my own argument.

Corrections and contact

If you spot an error, message me on X at @infinitumceo or email info@theinfinitumcorporation.com and I will look at it. See also the Contact page.
